steps.title: Orchard Logistics (Alice) holds 1,000 dDEP at Northvale Bank

steps.title: Bob sells Alice 100 dMMF for 100 dDEP: the trade arrives as a CDM instruction and settles on chain

audit.detail: Bob proposed delivery of 100 dMMF from Bob to Alice against payment of 100 dDEP from Alice to Bob (trade 0xa7f3737a16c9ca996c7c359b61cb18b5c38cab56b803a62dad76c4a219afb1d3, CDM reference 0x7eb3a50652534e2c3bf9df76bc868ad5a732c4faf2ef2be2759563393e2f6eb7)
